verdict.rationale: Asana's public API, webhooks, and 'app components' let third-party developers build integrations that update Asana status from other tools, and the App Directory lists apps that create tasks from external tools — but none of the evidence names a specific design-tool (e.g., Figma) integration for keeping project status updated, so this requires custom development rather than an out-of-box designer workflow. Missing for 10: a named/first-party design-tool (Figma, Adobe XD, etc.) integration or app-directory listing demonstrating status sync specifically for designers.
